ei.title: Seeds as the Best Survival Strategy
ei.subject: 영어2

fullPassage: Plants are amazing. Throughout their long existence, they have created diverse survival strategies. Seeds, in particular, are one of the strongest survival techniques they have developed. Let's discover the fascinating and mysterious world of seeds. Plants will do anything to spread their seeds. They offer tasty food to animals in return for distributing their seeds. Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, has a sweet smell that attracts animals, similar to pineapples and bananas. It tempts animals to eat delicious fruit flesh, thereby getting them to eat the seeds. The fruit flesh is digested by the animals that consume it, but the seeds are not digested and pass through the animals' digestive tracts untouched. When these animals poop out the seeds, the seeds begin to sprout and grow, and jackfruit spreads. In exchange for a satisfying meal, the animals spread the jackfruit seeds. Many plants opt to scatter their seeds by providing food to animals, but not all of them do. Some plants attach their seeds to passing animals, spreading them without any return benefit. Instead of tempting sweet fruits, these seeds are equipped with sharp hooks or needles. Devil's claw stands out as the most vicious of these plants. Devil's claw primarily inhabits the Kalahari Desert in South Africa, Namibia, and Botswana. Its blossoms resembling pink trumpets eventually transform into fruits with many hooks. As these fruits dry, they become solid, and their hooks become tough enough to attach to the bodies of animals. As animals pass by, the hooks extending in all directions will keep the dried fruit firmly attached to their fur. As the animals move away, the seeds from the fruit will be scattered in various locations. The attached hooks cause severe pain to the animals, making them feel like the devil is scratching them with its horrifying claws. That is how devil's claw became known as the worst free rider. Out of numerous creative methods for spreading seeds, silver arrow-reed in South Africa has a particularly unique one. Silver arrow-reed spreads its seeds by deceiving dung beetles. Dung beetles, by nature, roll antelope dung and bury it in the ground to eat or lay eggs in. Silver arrow-reed seeds are dark brown, round, and slightly larger than 1 cm in size. Their visual appearance and smell are quite similar to antelope dung. So when a seed falls onto the ground, dung beetles will approach the fallen seed within minutes. Then, they carefully roll the seed away as if it were antelope dung. That is why dung beetles are often spotted rolling silver arrow-reed seeds that look and smell like dung balls. When they try to eat the seeds or lay eggs inside of them, however, the confused beetles will realize they cannot. They have no choice but to abort and search for real dung balls. By tricking dung beetles into rolling away and burying the seeds, silver arrow-reed is able to spread and plant its seeds better. Not all seeds are transported by animals. Some are carried by the wind. This approach is used by maple trees. Maple seeds are shaped like a boomerang with irregular ridges on the surface. When a maple seed falls from the tree, it spins around. This rotation makes the seed stay in the air longer and fly farther. It is similar to how helicopters get lifted and stay in the air using their propellers. The rotation caused by its wings allows the maple seed to elevate twice as high as non-rotating seeds. As a result, it can travel much farther from the parent tree. The rotation also slows down the speed of the fall, and the seed softly lands on the ground. This helps reduce the damage to the seed during the fall. In most cases, mature seeds are automatically separated from the parent plant. However, some plants only release their seeds after enduring an extreme experience. Eucalyptus is one such example. Eucalyptus seeds are as tiny as grains of sand, but they are bound together in firm capsules. Birds cannot eat them because they are securely protected by a strong shell. In long periods of hot and dry weather, eucalyptus leaves rub together and naturally catch fire because the leaves contain highly flammable oil. The extreme heat from the fire causes the shell to crack open. Finally, the seeds come out of the shell, hit the ground, and begin to grow. The fallen seeds are conveniently concealed in the soft ash left over after the fire, which protects them from the harsh environment. Wildfire, often started by the parent tree, also burns practically everything on the ground, destroying other plants that would compete with the seeds for the water and sunlight needed for growth. As you can see, eucalyptus is only able to reproduce provided that there is fire.

questions.passage: Plants will do anything to spread their seeds. They offer (A)[tasty / tasteless] food to animals in return for distributing their seeds. Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, has a sweet smell that (B)[repels / attracts] animals, similar to pineapples and bananas. It tempts animals to eat (C)[delicious / disgusting] fruit flesh, thereby getting them to eat the seeds. The fruit flesh is digested by the animals that consume it, but the seeds are not digested and pass through the animals' digestive tracts untouched. When these animals poop out the seeds, the seeds begin to sprout and grow, and jackfruit spreads.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ (A) tasty(맛있는): 동물에게 '맛있는' 먹이를 제공한다는 문맥에 맞음

✅ (B) attracts(끌어들이다): 달콤한 향기가 동물을 '끌어들인다'는 문맥에 맞음

✅ (C) delicious(맛있는): 동물이 '맛있는' 과육을 먹도록 유혹한다는 문맥에 맞음

❌ tasteless(맛없는)·repels(쫓아내다)·disgusting(역겨운)은 모두 반대 의미 ← 정답은 ①

questions.passage: Many plants opt to scatter their seeds by providing food to animals, but not all of them do. Some plants (A)[attach / detach] their seeds to passing animals, spreading them without any return benefit. Instead of tempting sweet fruits, these seeds are equipped with (B)[blunt / sharp] hooks or needles. Devil's claw stands out as the most (C)[vicious / gentle] of these plants. Devil's claw primarily inhabits the Kalahari Desert in South Africa, Namibia, and Botswana. Its blossoms resembling pink trumpets eventually transform into fruits with many hooks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ (A) attach(붙이다): 씨앗을 지나가는 동물에게 '붙인다'는 문맥에 맞음

✅ (B) sharp(날카로운): 씨앗이 '날카로운' 갈고리나 바늘을 갖추었다는 문맥에 맞음

✅ (C) vicious(악랄한): devil's claw가 가장 '악랄한' 식물이라는 문맥에 맞음

❌ detach(떼어내다)·blunt(무딘)·gentle(온순한)은 모두 반대 의미 ← 정답은 ②

questions.passage: Maple seeds are shaped like a boomerang with irregular ridges on the surface. When a maple seed falls from the tree, it spins around. This rotation makes the seed stay in the air (A)[longer / shorter] and fly farther. It is similar to how helicopters get lifted and stay in the air using their propellers. The rotation caused by its wings allows the maple seed to (B)[lower / elevate] twice as high as non-rotating seeds. As a result, it can travel much farther from the parent tree. The rotation also (C)[slows / speeds] down the speed of the fall, and the seed softly lands on the ground.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ (A) longer(더 오래): 회전이 씨앗을 공중에 '더 오래' 머물게 한다는 문맥에 맞음

✅ (B) elevate(올라가다): 회전이 씨앗을 두 배 더 높이 '올라가게' 한다는 문맥에 맞음

✅ (C) slows(늦추다): 회전이 낙하 속도를 '늦춘다'는 문맥에 맞음

❌ shorter(더 짧게)·lower(낮추다)·speeds(빠르게 하다)는 모두 반대 ← 정답은 ③

questions.passage: In most cases, mature seeds are automatically ①<u>separated</u> from the parent plant. However, some plants only ②<u>release</u> their seeds after enduring an extreme experience. Eucalyptus is one such example. Eucalyptus seeds are as ③<u>tiny</u> as grains of sand, but they are bound together in firm capsules. Birds cannot eat them because they are ④<u>carelessly</u> protected by a strong shell. In long periods of hot and dry weather, eucalyptus leaves rub together and naturally catch fire because the leaves contain highly flammable oil.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ carelessly → securely: 씨앗은 강한 껍질로 '단단히' 보호된다
det.analysis:
✅ ① separated(분리된): 성숙한 씨앗이 모체에서 '분리된다'는 문맥에 적절

✅ ② release(방출하다): 일부 식물은 극한 경험 후에야 씨앗을 '방출한다'는 문맥에 적절

✅ ③ tiny(아주 작은): eucalyptus 씨앗이 모래알만큼 '작다'는 문맥에 적절

❌ ④ carelessly(부주의하게) → securely(단단히): 강한 껍질로 '단단히' 보호되므로 securely가 맞음 ← 정답

questions.passage: Out of numerous creative methods for spreading seeds, silver arrow-reed in South Africa has a particularly unique one. Silver arrow-reed spreads its seeds by ①<u>assisting</u> dung beetles. Dung beetles, by nature, roll antelope dung and ②<u>bury</u> it in the ground to eat or lay eggs in. Silver arrow-reed seeds are dark brown, round, and slightly ③<u>larger</u> than 1 cm in size. Their ④<u>visual</u> appearance and smell are quite similar to antelope dung. So when a seed falls onto the ground, dung beetles will approach the fallen seed within minutes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① assisting → deceiving: silver arrow-reed는 쇠똥구리를 '속여서' 씨앗을 퍼뜨린다
det.analysis:
❌ ① assisting(돕는) → deceiving(속이는): 쇠똥구리를 '속여서' 씨앗을 퍼뜨리므로 deceiving이 맞음 ← 정답

✅ ② bury(묻다): 쇠똥구리가 배설물을 땅에 '묻는다'는 문맥에 적절

✅ ③ larger(더 큰): 씨앗이 1cm보다 약간 '더 크다'는 문맥에 적절

✅ ④ visual(시각적인): 씨앗의 '겉모습'과 냄새가 배설물과 유사하다는 문맥에 적절

questions.passage: Its blossoms resembling pink trumpets eventually ①<u>transform</u> into fruits with many hooks. As these fruits dry, they become ②<u>soft</u>, and their hooks become tough enough to attach to the bodies of animals. As animals pass by, the hooks extending in all directions will keep the dried fruit ③<u>firmly</u> attached to their fur. As the animals move away, the seeds from the fruit will be scattered in various locations. The attached hooks cause ④<u>severe</u> pain to the animals, making them feel like the devil is scratching them with its horrifying claws.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① transform(변하다): 꽃이 갈고리가 있는 열매로 '변한다'는 문맥에 적절

❌ ② soft(부드러운) → solid(단단한): 열매가 마르면서 '단단해지므로' solid가 맞음 ← 정답

✅ ③ firmly(단단히): 갈고리가 열매를 털에 '단단히' 붙게 한다는 문맥에 적절

✅ ④ severe(심한): 갈고리가 동물에게 '심한' 통증을 유발한다는 문맥에 적절

questions.passage: It tempts animals to eat delicious fruit flesh, thereby getting them to eat the seeds. The fruit flesh is digested by the animals that consume it, but the seeds are not digested and pass through the animals' digestive tracts untouched. When these animals poop out the seeds, the seeds begin to __________ and grow, and jackfruit spreads. In exchange for a satisfying meal, the animals spread the jackfruit seeds. Many plants opt to scatter their seeds by providing food to animals, but not all of them do.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
동물이 씨앗을 배설하면 씨앗이 '싹트고(sprout)' 자라기 시작한다는 흐름이다.

❌ wither(시들다)·decay(썩다)는 자라는 흐름과 반대

❌ float(뜨다)는 문맥과 무관

✅ sprout(싹트다): 'begin to ___ and grow' 흐름에 맞음 ← 정답

questions.passage: This approach is used by maple trees. Maple seeds are shaped like a boomerang with irregular ridges on the surface. When a maple seed falls from the tree, it __________ around. This rotation makes the seed stay in the air longer and fly farther. It is similar to how helicopters get lifted and stay in the air using their propellers. The rotation caused by its wings allows the maple seed to elevate twice as high as non-rotating seeds.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
바로 다음 문장에서 'This rotation(이 회전)'이라고 받으므로 빈칸에는 '회전한다'는 의미의 spins가 와야 한다.

❌ sinks(가라앉다)·stops(멈추다)·melts(녹다)는 회전과 무관

✅ spins(빙글빙글 돌다): 뒤의 rotation과 연결 ← 정답

questions.passage: Birds cannot eat them because they are securely protected by a strong shell. In long periods of hot and dry weather, eucalyptus leaves rub together and naturally catch fire because the leaves contain highly __________ oil. The extreme heat from the fire causes the shell to crack open. Finally, the seeds come out of the shell, hit the ground, and begin to grow. The fallen seeds are conveniently concealed in the soft ash left over after the fire, which protects them from the harsh environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
잎이 서로 마찰하며 '자연적으로 불이 붙는(catch fire)' 이유를 설명하므로, 기름이 '불이 잘 붙는(flammable)' 성질이어야 한다.

✅ flammable(인화성의): catch fire와 연결 ← 정답

❌ waterproof(방수의)·fireproof(내화성의)·flexible(유연한)은 불이 붙는 흐름과 반대이거나 무관

questions.passage: Many plants opt to scatter their seeds by providing food to animals, but not all of them do. Some plants attach their seeds to passing animals, spreading them without any return benefit. Instead of tempting sweet fruits, these seeds are equipped with sharp hooks or needles. Devil's claw stands out as the most <u>vicious</u> of these plants. Devil's claw primarily inhabits the Kalahari Desert in South Africa, Namibia, and Botswana.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 vicious와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
vicious는 '악랄한, 잔인한'이라는 뜻이다.

❌ gentle(온순한)·generous(관대한)·honest(정직한)는 모두 반대이거나 무관

✅ cruel(잔인한): vicious와 가장 가까움 ← 정답

questions.passage: Plants are amazing. Throughout their long existence, they have created diverse survival strategies. Seeds, in particular, are one of the strongest survival techniques they have developed. Let's discover the <u>fascinating</u> and mysterious world of seeds. Plants will do anything to spread their seeds.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 fascinating과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
fascinating은 '매혹적인, 흥미로운'이라는 뜻이다.

❌ dull(지루한)·ordinary(평범한)은 반대 의미

❌ frightening(무서운)은 무관

✅ captivating(매혹적인): fascinating과 가장 가까움 ← 정답

questions.passage: Out of <u>numerous</u> creative methods for spreading seeds, silver arrow-reed in South Africa has a particularly unique one. Silver arrow-reed spreads its seeds by deceiving dung beetles. Dung beetles, by nature, roll antelope dung and bury it in the ground to eat or lay eggs in. Silver arrow-reed seeds are dark brown, round, and slightly larger than 1 cm in size. Their visual appearance and smell are quite similar to antelope dung.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 numerous와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
numerous는 '수많은, 많은'이라는 뜻이다.

❌ strange(이상한)·tiny(아주 작은)는 무관

❌ few(거의 없는)는 반대 의미

✅ many(많은): numerous와 가장 가까움 ← 정답

questions.passage: In most cases, <u>mature</u> seeds are automatically separated from the parent plant. However, some plants only release their seeds after enduring an extreme experience. Eucalyptus is one such example. Eucalyptus seeds are as tiny as grains of sand, but they are bound together in firm capsules. Birds cannot eat them because they are securely protected by a strong shell.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 mature와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
mature는 '성숙한, 다 자란'이라는 뜻이다.

❌ ripe(익은)·adult(다 자란)·grown(성장한)은 모두 비슷한 의미(동의어)

✅ young(어린): mature와 가장 반대 ← 정답

questions.passage: As these fruits dry, they become solid, and their hooks become tough enough to attach to the bodies of animals. As animals pass by, the hooks extending in all directions will keep the dried fruit firmly attached to their fur. As the animals move away, the seeds from the fruit will be scattered in various locations. The attached hooks cause <u>severe</u> pain to the animals, making them feel like the devil is scratching them with its horrifying claws. That is how devil's claw became known as the worst free rider.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 severe와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
severe는 '심한, 극심한'이라는 뜻이다.

❌ intense(강렬한)·harsh(가혹한)·serious(심각한)는 모두 비슷한 의미(동의어)

✅ mild(약한): severe와 가장 반대 ← 정답

questions.passage:
(A) Dung beetles, by nature, <u>roll</u> antelope dung and bury it in the ground to eat or lay eggs in.
(B) For breakfast, I bought a warm, freshly baked <u>roll</u> at the bakery.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 roll이 각각 어떤 의미로 쓰였는지 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
(A)에서 roll은 쇠똥구리가 배설물을 '굴리다(동사)'라는 뜻으로 쓰였다.

(B)에서 roll은 빵집에서 산 '둥근 빵(명사)'을 뜻한다.

✅ 따라서 (A) 굴리다, (B) 둥근 빵 ← 정답은 ②

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
to throw or drop things in different directions over an area

det.analysis:
'to throw or drop things in different directions over an area(여러 방향으로 넓게 흩뜨리다)'는 scatter의 정의이다.

❌ digest(소화하다)·inhabit(서식하다)·transform(변형시키다)은 정의와 무관

✅ scatter(흩뿌리다) ← 정답

questions.passage: As these fruits dry, they become solid, and their hooks become tough enough to attach to the bodies of animals. As animals pass by, the hooks extending in all directions will keep the dried fruit firmly _____ to their fur. (attach)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어(attach)를 문맥과 어법에 맞는 형태로 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.analysis:
'keep + 목적어 + 과거분사' 구문으로, 열매가 '붙어 있는' 상태를 나타내야 하므로 attach를 과거분사 attached로 바꿔야 한다.

 keep the dried fruit firmly attached(열매가 단단히 붙어 있게 하다)

questions.passage: Wildfire, often started by the parent tree, also burns practically everything on the ground, destroying other plants that would compete with the seeds for the water and sunlight needed for growth. As you can see, eucalyptus is only able to _____ provided that there is fire. (reproduction)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어(reproduction)를 문맥과 어법에 맞는 형태로 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.analysis:
'be able to + 동사원형' 구문이므로 명사 reproduction을 동사원형 reproduce로 바꿔야 한다.

 eucalyptus is only able to reproduce(번식할 수 있다)
det.tip: be able to + 동사원형 / reproduction(명사) → reproduce(동사)

questions.passage: As these fruits dry, they become solid, and their hooks become tough enough to attach to the bodies of animals. As animals pass by, the hooks extending in all directions will keep the dried fruit firmly attached to their fur. As the animals move away, the seeds from the fruit will be scattered in various locations. The attached hooks cause severe pain to the animals, making them feel like the devil is scratching them with its horrifying claws. That is how devil's claw became known as the worst __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
devil's claw는 아무 보답 없이 동물에게 고통만 주며 씨앗을 옮기게 하므로, '최악의 무임승차자(worst free rider)'로 알려졌다는 흐름이다.

✅ free rider(무임승차자): 보답 없이 이득만 취하는 존재 ← 정답

❌ loyal partner(충실한 동반자)·generous host(관대한 주인)·busy worker(바쁜 일꾼)는 보답 없이 이용하는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: free rider=무임승차자(대가 없이 이득만 취하는 자)

questions.passage: The extreme heat from the fire causes the shell to crack open. Finally, the seeds come out of the shell, hit the ground, and begin to grow. The fallen seeds are conveniently __________ in the soft ash left over after the fire, which protects them from the harsh environment. Wildfire, often started by the parent tree, also burns practically everything on the ground, destroying other plants that would compete with the seeds for the water and sunlight needed for growth. As you can see, eucalyptus is only able to reproduce provided that there is fire.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
떨어진 씨앗이 부드러운 재 속에 '감춰져서(concealed)' 가혹한 환경으로부터 보호된다는 흐름이다.

❌ exposed(노출된)는 보호된다는 흐름과 반대

❌ destroyed(파괴된)·frozen(얼어붙은)은 보호 맥락과 무관

✅ concealed(감춰진): protects them과 연결 ← 정답
